import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Aggregate sales data by product and date
daily_sales = coffee_sales.groupby(['date', 'product'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set the figure size
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 7))

# Create a line plot
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='date', y='total', hue='product')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Daily Sales Total by Product', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='Product', loc='upper left')

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Aggregate sales data by product and date
daily_sales = coffee_sales.groupby(['date', 'product'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set the figure size
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 7))

# Create a line plot
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='date', y='total', hue='product')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Daily Sales Total by Product', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='Product', loc='upper left')

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
